About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

Branch's Risk & Recovery organization operates as two arms. Operations owns execution: the queues, service levels, case work and day-to-day vendor delivery that keep users whole. Enablement owns intent: what the operation should aim at, how it is measured, and which controls, tooling and processes get built to get there. As Director of Risk & Recovery Enablement, you lead the second arm.

You will own the strategy and roadmap for how Branch detects, prevents and responds to fraud, scams, first-party fraud, identity abuse and financial crime, and the control environment underneath it. That includes the detection rules, the control paths users go through once flagged, and the financial crime tooling and process. You will not run daily case execution. You decide what that execution is aiming at, and you are accountable for whether the strategy measurably reduces loss without adding friction for legitimate users.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small team of specialists and do substantive analytical and design work yourself. You partner with the Risk & Recovery Operations leader as a peer; neither role reports to the other. This role suits someone who builds things rather than waiting to receive them.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Roadmap:

  • Partner with the head of Risk & Recovery to set the organization's annual priorities, and own the roadmap, milestones and measures that deliver the Enablement priorities
  • Translate loss performance, portfolio exposure and regulatory change into a prioritized investment agenda, and defend that prioritization to executive leadership
  • Define the measurement framework the organization is held to: what counts as a loss, including consistent definitions of scam, first-party and third-party fraud losses across Fraud, Disputes and Collections, how detection lift is quantified, and how false-positive cost and good-user friction are accounted for
  • Make build-versus-buy recommendations across the risk platform stack, holding vendors to modeled outcomes rather than roadmap promises
  • Partner with the Operations arm to turn strategy into operational requirements, and resolve the cases where operational reality contradicts a strategic assumption
  • Own Branch's membership in the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA) and similar industry intelligence-sharing bodies. Direct how shared scam signals are used in detection and controls, and track scam regulation, including US reimbursement proposals

Detection & Control Environment:

  • Own the design and tuning strategy for Branch's automated fraud and risk controls, including SEON, real-time decisioning on card authorizations, and real-time alerting
  • Set risk tolerance thresholds and approve material rule and threshold changes, balancing loss exposure against user friction and approval rates
  • Own the control paths users enter once flagged (step-up, holds, locks, review queues, unlock and recovery), and the standard for when each applies and how a legitimate user exits
  • Own the results of Branch's User Risk Score, the user-level view that sets each user's treatment: approve its design, risk bands and material changes. The Program Lead (Fraud Controls) builds and runs it
  • Ensure each control change reaches the operation: queue design, procedures and BPO rollout are updated with the Operations arm before a change goes live
  • Keep the control environment documented, explainable and defensible to Compliance, partner banks and external audit
  • Direct the response to emerging fraud typologies and post-incident findings, deciding what changes in the control layer when a new attack pattern appears

FinCrime Tooling & Process:

  • Lead the FinCrime Manager in owning Branch's transaction monitoring and case management platform and the investigation process built on it, including mule accounts that receive scam proceeds
  • Set the requirements, rollout sequence and success measures for financial crime tooling, in partnership with Data and Engineering
  • Partner with Compliance, which owns AML and BSA obligations, policy, risk tolerance and UAR decisions; this arm owns the tooling, process and operational performance inside them

Identity & Fraud Guardrails:

  • Own the fraud and identity verification guardrails Branch's onboarding experience operates within. Product owns the onboarding experience end to end and the identity verification tools
  • Own the fraud and identity metrics that come out of onboarding and bring them to the cross-functional onboarding review
  • Recommend verification thresholds with the risk and conversion tradeoff modeled; where Product accepts more risk for a better experience, document the tradeoff and agree it with Product
  • Own identity risk after the front door: account takeover detection and response, re-verification triggers, and the identity basis for offboarding

Automation & AI Requirements:

  • Set Risk & Recovery's requirements and priorities for automation and AI, and secure delivery from Branch's enterprise data, AI and engineering teams through clear requirements, sequencing and credibility
  • Judge where automation and AI are not warranted, and protect the organization from tooling that adds complexity without reducing loss

Governance & Standards:

  • Own Risk & Recovery's governance layer: standard operating procedures, rule documentation and change records that are kept current and auditable
  • Own the working relationships with Compliance, Product and Engineering on behalf of the Enablement arm
  • Represent the organization's capabilities and gaps accurately to partner banks, auditors and executive stakeholders

Leadership & Team Development:

  • Lead a team of specialist owners covering rules and monitoring, financial crime, fraud controls and project delivery, and develop each into a strategic operator
  • Establish the operating cadence, prioritization discipline and written standards for an arm that does not yet have them
  • Build the function's credibility so partner teams seek its input before decisions are made rather than after


What We're Looking For:

Required

  • 8+ years in financial services or fintech risk, fraud or payments, with meaningful exposure to consumer deposit and/or card products
  • 4+ years leading a risk program or team, including ownership of a roadmap and the investment case behind it
  • Depth in fraud prevention and detection strategy: rules, models, vendor decisioning platforms, and the tradeoff between loss reduction and user friction
  • Experience with transaction monitoring and case management platforms, and with how financial crime tooling supports AML and BSA programs
  • Hands-on experience with identity verification, account takeover and onboarding fraud controls
  • Data fluency sufficient to interrogate analysis independently: comfortable with SQL and business intelligence tooling, and able to tell a defensible model from a persuasive one
  • A record of securing delivery from partner teams and vendors through clear requirements and credibility rather than escalation
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication; able to defend a prioritization decision to a chief operating officer and to a partner bank in the same week
  • Comfort building in the absence of structure, and the discipline to create it

Nice to Have

  • Experience setting requirements for an AI or automation capability delivered by a partner team inside a risk organization
  • Working knowledge of disputes and chargebacks, including Regulation E obligations and Mastercard rules, sufficient to direct strategy without owning case execution
  • Exposure to collections, recovery or consumer credit loss management
  • Experience in a scaling fintech, particularly through a credit or lending product launch
  • Familiarity with earned wage access, paycheck advance, or gig and staffing platforms
  • Experience in scam prevention or first-party fraud strategy, or with industry intelligence-sharing bodies such as GASA
  • CFCS, CAMS, CFE or comparable industry certification

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $185-195k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc. 

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits: 

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance 
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com
